title: Chicken and veg stir-fry with brown rice
steps: Start the rice if it isn't cooked yet: brown rice takes 25 to 30 minutes (follow the pack). Leftover rice is fine; reheat it until steaming hot.
Cut the chicken into thin strips, cut the broccoli into small florets and slice the pepper and carrot thinly.
Heat the oil in a wok or large pan over high heat and stir-fry the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes, until golden and no longer pink inside.
Add the vegetables and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes, so they stay a little crunchy.
Add a splash of soy sauce with some crushed garlic and grated ginger, toss for 1 to 2 minutes and serve on the rice.
